title: Al Tayer Motors Launches Deepal's Newest Model S05 in the UAE
text:
Al Tayer Motors Launches Deepal’s Newest Model S05 in the UAE
Al Tayer Motors, one of the UAE’s premier automotive dealerships, has launched the highly anticipated DEEPAL S05 compact SUV from DEEPAL, the intelligent mobility brand under Changan Automotive.
Designed to be compact, confident, affordable and intelligent, the S05 introduces a new benchmark for everyday mobility in the UAE. It follows the successful debut of the DEEPAL S07 in the country earlier this year.
Speaking about the launch, Ashok Khanna, Chief Executive Officer, Al Tayer Motors said, “We are delighted to unveil DEEPAL’s newest model within a span of just four months, a testament to the significant interest and enthusiasm the brand has garnered since its introduction in the UAE. I am confident that the S05 will further enhance the momentum established by the S07 and broaden the appeal of this innovative EV brand among discerning customers.”
DEEPAL vehicles are available for customers to purchase through https://www.altayermotors.com/deepal/ or via the Al Tayer Motors app. Test drives can be booked via these platforms and by contacting the showroom via 800 MOTORS.
“The DEEPAL S05 reflects our vision to bring cutting-edge electric innovation to everyday drivers,” said Mr Xiao, General Manager of Changan Automobile's Middle East and Africa Division. “With its dual-power flexibility, sleek design, and connected cockpit, the S05 is built for UAE customers who want both advanced technology and practical style.”
Smart, Stylish, and Powerful, Ready for the UAE Roads
The DEEPAL S05 is available in two variants:
• EV – offering a fully electric range of up to 460 km
• REEV (Range Extended Electric Vehicle) – offering an electric range of 160 km with a fuel-based extender for longer drives, and the combined range is more than 900km
Built on DEEPAL’s Changan Platform Architecture (CPA) and powered by next-generation electric architecture, the S05 combines rear-wheel drive performance with an aerodynamic silhouette and a futuristic driving experience.
Key Specifications
• Powertrain: High-efficiency rear motor (160KW for REV, 175KW for BEV), REEV engine with 1.5L range extender
• Dimensions: 4,620mm length, 1,900mm width, 1,600mm height ,2880mm wheelbase– sleek and agile
• Design: Hidden door handles, frameless window, Smart Flying Wing Headlights with Luminous Eye Style
• Interior: AR-HUD (Headup Display), 15.4” central control screen, panoramic sunroof, wireless phone charging, Qualcomm Snapdragon 8155 Chip
• Connectivity: Voice interaction, OTA upgrades, app-based remote control, Online Navigation, Online Application (Video, Podcast, Music)
• Safety: intelligent driving assist (IACC, Lane change assist, Blind Spot Monitoring), full suite of passive safety features
• Comfort: Queen seats, Front row seat ventilation and electrical adjustment
• Charging (For vehicle): 30~80% SoC charging time: 20min (REV), 15min (BEV)
The DEEPAL S05’s smart cockpit experience is designed to make every drive intuitive and immersive, blending physical comfort with intelligent digital features. The rear-wheel drive setup ensures responsive handling and dynamic control in urban and highway settings.
With over 40 years of success in the automotive sector, multiple award-winning Al Tayer Motors is dedicated to providing exceptional customer experiences through its impressive infrastructure and innovative digital platforms.
Background Information
Al Tayer Motors
Al Tayer Motors was established in 1982 and represents major European and American automobile manufacturers such as Land Rover, Jaguar, Ford, Lincoln, Ferrari and Maserati across the UAE. Al Tayer Motors’ portfolio also includes commercial vehicles - Ford Trucks in the UAE.
As a company, we deal with a discerning customer who demands the best. From this stand point, we created a unique retail and service environment to meet our brands’ expected service standards.
The automobiles we sell provide immense pleasure and satisfaction to their owners and we add value by ensuring the joy is uninterrupted. Dedicated service, sales and parts centers in addition to world class personnel provide each customer with a unique ownership experience.
